channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sarunas Jasikevicius | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sarunas Jasikevicius from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Nick Nurse on an assistant job interview with Sarunas Jasikevicius last summer:

“I had a dozen calls with him. I watched his teams play & I liked what I saw. He's obviously up-and-coming or”

Nick Nurse on Sarunas Jasikevicius, Sep 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Warren LeGarie on Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:NBA agent Warren LeGarie on Sarunas Jasikevicius potential to become an NBA head coach:

“All it takes is one team. If somebody feels they need the type of coach that he is, that their team lacks spirit, somebody who gets into the fray or gets emotional, that could happen”

Warren LeGarie on Sarunas Jasikevicius, Jul 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Jonas Valanciunas on Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Valanciunas on what NBA people talk about Sarunas Jasikevicius:

“They say really good things about him. It’s a coach, who made some incredible things despite still being in early years of head coaching career. But we’ll see. It’s not up to me.”

Jonas Valanciunas on Sarunas Jasikevicius, Jun 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Jonas Valanciunas on Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Valanciunas on Jasikevicius NBA head coaching job potential:

“He would need to make adjustments, but everything is possible for him. He is still growing coaching and he knows how to adapt and what to change to become NBA head coach. I think there would be no problem with it.”

Jonas Valanciunas on Sarunas Jasikevicius, May 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Rimas Kurtinaitis on David Blatt, Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Rimas Kurtinaitis:

“We have David Blatt’s example, of course. He did a great job in Cleveland, but the club still wasn’t satisfied for some reason. Probably because he tried to enforce discipline on the team. How do you enforce the rules with these millionaires in the NBA anyway? I don’t think Sarunas Jasikevicius needs to jump into a head coaching job in the NBA right away. He’s a very talented, smart, promising coach, but first he should test the water and gain some experience in American basketball.”

Rimas Kurtinaitis on David Blatt, Sarunas Jasikevicius, May 9, 2019. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Maurizio Gherardini on Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Gherardini on Jasikevicius NBA market value:

“Knowing how NBA works & the interest before last summer, season like this recognizes him again that he is a prospect for any team in the world. Saras showed that he is definitely elite coach in Europe & can coach anywhere any moment.”

Maurizio Gherardini on Sarunas Jasikevicius, Apr 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.
